SECTION A: Multiple Choice Questions (1 Mark Each)

Q14. Which one of the following political parties is a State Party?  
(A) Bharatiya Janata Party  
(B) Bahujan Samaj Party  
(C) Mizo National Front  
(D) Communist Party of India (Marxist)

Answer / Solution:
Which one of the following political parties is a State Party? 
(C) Mizo National Front 
Reasoning: BJP and BSP are National Parties. Mizo National Front is a State 
Party.
